units.text: Specialist-led dental care delivered across two Hyderabad locations, led by the clinicians who built the practice.
Founded Neodent in Hyderabad in 1994 and continues to lead its clinical direction across Mehdipatnam and Nampally.
BDS, MDS, FICOI · Assistant Professor of Prosthodontics
Leads implant, prosthodontic and full mouth rehabilitation care at both Neodent branches.
